Royals News

October 23, 2026

Important Information

PE Uniform Store Open

The PE Uniform Store is open again. Please place your order by Sunday, October 23.

To order, visit www.khroyals.com and navigate to Student Life > PE Uniform Store.

KH Merch Store

Show your Royals spirit wherever you go! The KH Merch Store is the perfect place to find gear for students, parents, grandparents, and supporters. Whether you're cheering on our student athletes, attending school events, or representing Kingdom Heights around town, there's something for everyone.


Visit the KH Merch Store here!

Save the Date: K-12 Parent Meeting

Parents are asked to attend one of our upcoming parent meetings on Thursday, November 5. Two sessions will be offered to accommodate family schedules: Session 1: 1:45 PM | Session 2: 6:00 PM. Please plan to attend the session that works best for your family.

Save the Dates: Spirit Week

Spirit Week is October 26–30! We invite all students to join in the fun by participating in each day's themed dress-up activities as we celebrate school spirit together. The Book Fair will also be on campus all week.

The week will conclude with our annual Fall Fest on Friday, a favorite tradition filled with games, activities, and community celebration.

zoom_out_map Show in original size

Fall Fest 🍂

Join us on Friday, October 30, as we wrap up Spirit Week with our annual Fall Fest - a day of fall fun and fellowship for our Royals!

  • K2-K4: 9:00-10:30 AM

  • Kindergarten-12th Grade: 12:00-2:30 PM

Students will enjoy bounce houses, face painting, games, and more! Kona Ice and Tom's Coffee Truck will also be on campus with items available for purchase for K-12th grade.

If you'd like to be part of making this event a success, we invite you to sign up to volunteer. You're also welcome to share the signup link with family and friends who may be interested in supporting Fall Fest through a donation. Thank you for helping us make this a special day for our school community!

Sign up here.

Dunk Tank for D.C. 💦

We're looking for enthusiastic volunteers to take a turn in the dunk tank during Fall Fest to help raise funds for our 8th grade Washington, D.C., field trip!


Whether you're a dad, grandparent, mom, pastor, teacher, dean, or another member of our school community, we'd love to have you participate. Volunteer time slots are just 15 minutes long, and you're welcome to sign up for as many as you'd like.


Students will have the chance to test their aim for $2 for 3 throws, with all proceeds benefiting the Washington, D.C., field trip fund. Sign up here!

Rocktober Family Night

The Rock Family Worship Center is hosting a Family Night on Sunday, October 25, from 4:00–7:00 PM. Tickets are $5 per person.


Bring the whole family for an evening of food trucks, a petting zoo, pumpkin decorating, and fellowship with our community. Register here!
